name: feature.work-selection.nodes
description: Work-selection node pack (ADR 0534) — read the ranking the autonomous work loop would apply to a board's To Do lane, with the per-criterion values behind each score (due-date urgency, stated priority, age, blocked). READ-ONLY by design: selection is host policy a workflow may observe but never author, so there is no node that reorders or starts anything.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Work Selection: Preview Ranking
nodes.description: Returns the ranking the autonomous work loop would apply to a board's To Do lane right now, via ctx.features['work-selection'].preview. Inputs: { boardId }. Output: { ranked: [{ cardId, title, rank, score, why: [{ criterionId, criterion, value }] }], count }. An unknown or cross-tenant board returns an empty list rather than an error.
